entries.title: Psalms 149:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The Lord - He rejoiceth over them to do them good. Beautify - Heb. adorn, make them amiable and honourable in the eyes of the world, who now hate and despise them. The meek - All true Israelites are such.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: In glory - For the honour which God putteth upon them. Beds - By night as well as by day.

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Vengeance - For all their cruelties and injuries towards God's people. This was literally accomplished by David upon the Philistines, Ammonites, Syrians and other neighbouring nations.

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Written - Appointed and declared in the holy scripture. Chapter CL An exhortation to praise God with all sorts of musical instruments, ver. 1 - 6.
